title: viburnum edule
intro: Viburnum edule, commonly known as Mountain Sweet, is a plant species native to North America, belonging to the Adoxaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum edule are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include viburnin, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
